captions.detailed: A remote-actuated electronic dropper seatpost assembly consisting of a black outer frame tube, a telescoping inner seatpost tube, and a wireless remote lever mounted on a handlebar segment. The inner tube slides telescopically (prismatically) inside the outer tube, capped with a flat saddle mounting bracket at the top. The handlebar-mounted remote lever rotates on a hinge to simulate actuation of the seatpost dropper mechanism.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a remote-actuated electronic dropper seatpost. The model should include a cylindrical outer tube, a telescoping inner tube with a saddle mounting bracket, a handlebar segment, and an articulating remote lever. Configure a prismatic joint for the seatpost telescoping action and a revolute joint for the remote lever.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube and inner tube using Cylinder primitives, adding a Box for the saddle clamp bracket. Create the handlebar and remote lever using Cylinder and Box primitives. Define the assembly links and establish a prismatic joint between the outer and inner tubes, and a revolute joint between the handlebar clamp and the remote lever.
